column1: # Nouns for 🏗️ Sentence Builder and verb sentences in the other games.
# One line per built-in word that sentences may use (untagged words are never used;
# words the player adds never are either). Columns (tab-separated):
#   korean  pack  kinds  english  general  at  to  tags
# korean: the word's Korean1 or Korean2; pack: its home Word Pack.
# kinds: what the word can be in a sentence; verbs.ini picks nouns by kind or by name.
# english: the noun as used in an English sentence ("an apple", "the library", "{my} hands").
# general: the form for habits and likes, used in the present tense ("apples"); blank = same.
# at / to: where-phrases ("in the park", "home"); blank = "at <english>" / "to <english>".
# tags: pl = plural (as a subject); he / she = only with a male / female owner ("my wife").
